pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ([a-zA-Z0-9\s]+) AS T1 JOIN ([a-zA-Z0-9\s]+) AS T2 ON T1.\w+ = T2.\w+ WHERE YEAR\(\w+\.\w+\) IN \(([0-9]{4}),([0-9]{4})\) GROUP BY T1.\w+ HAVING COUNT\(DISTINCT YEAR\(T1.\w+\)\) = ([0-9]+)
correction: Replace the query with SELECT <column_name> FROM <table_name> WHERE YEAR = <year1> INTERSECT SELECT <column_name> FROM <table_name> WHERE YEAR = <year2>

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly use JOIN and subqueries when a simple INTERSECT operation would suffice for finding common values across specific years.
